# Bloom Towers

> Bloom Towers is a three-tower residential development in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, with 944 apartments arranged above a shared ground floor and four-level podium. Tower A rises 39 floors while Towers B and C reach 29 each, giving overall heights of 44 and 34 storeys. Residents share swimming pools, gymnasiums, a landscaped podium deck and a co-working area, with retail units at street level.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2020

## MENASCO Scope

Bloom Towers is a three-tower residential development by Bloom Properties in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, with 944 apartments set above a shared four-level podium. Tower A rises 39 floors and Towers B and C 29 floors each, supported by amenities including pools, gyms and a co-working space. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the development, which was completed in 2020.
